services.name: Shake Your Trail Feather-Kayak Rental Only
services.desc: This purchase is to rent a single or double, sit on top kayak, ONLY for the Shake Your Trail Feather event put on by the TECHE Project on Saturday, October 18th, 2025. Life jacket and paddle are also included. There are two options for this event, with one being the 4.5 mi./2 hr. paddle to Parc des Ponts in Breaux Bridge OR the longer 6.5 mi./2.45 hr. paddle to Lil’s on the Teche in Breaux Bridge. Wanderlust Rentals does not facilitate transportation for this event There will be a Pre-Paddle Shuttle ($5 cash at the bus) from each location. The shuttle bus leaves Lil’s at 9 a.m. and Parc des Ponts at 9:15

services.name: Vermilionville to Lake Charlo (Guided Tour)
services.desc: Experience a perfect blend of adventure and relaxation as we guide you through a scenic journey on the water. Event Highlights: Your paddle begins at Vermilionville’s kayak dock, heading upstream along Bayou Vermilion with a unique view behind Lafayette Regional Airport—keep an eye out for planes taking off! We’ll then navigate Bayou Tortue’s winding path, immersing in the tranquil beauty of its wildlife-rich waters before reaching the serenity of Charlo Lake. services.name: Day Rental
services.desc: What to Expect: You will be responsible for picking up your rental, transporting it, and returning it by the end of the day. Please bring a strap or rope to secure the kayak to your vehicle. Please pick up your rental at 437 East Kaliste Saloom Road. This is one of our self-service locations located on the Vermilion Bayou (see pic of kiosk). We also have short term rentals on the same 2.5-acre property so please respect guests' privacy if they are there. Directions: When pulling onto the property, go to the back right corner of the property which is where you will be able to scan and unlock your kayak by using the ShareKayak app (download on App Store or Google Play).
